title: UN Warns West Bank Has Reached 'Critical Point' Amid Escalating Settler Violence
detail: The United Nations warned that the West Bank has reached a 'critical point' as settler violence and Palestinian displacement continue to escalate. The alert reflects growing international alarm over the deteriorating situation in the territory, where increased settler encroachment and displacement of Palestinian communities have prompted urgent calls for international action.

title: Israeli Ambassador Danon Defends West Bank Settlements at UN Security Council
detail: Israeli UN Ambassador Danny Danon appeared before the UN Security Council to defend Israeli settlements in the West Bank, declaring that Israel 'is not going anywhere.' The remarks came as the UN warned that the West Bank had reached a 'critical point,' underscoring the widening gap between Israeli government positions and international calls to halt settlement expansion and settler violence.
